claims.evidence: No documentation, import sticker, or voltage/plug evidence shown in any photo.
No photo of the counter/display screen showing total page count.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted
claims.evidence: Machine is shown wrapped and closed; no photo of open toner/drum compartment or receipt for parts.
No power-on or test-copy video/photo showing paper feeding through.

claims.claim: Packed with extensive superb performance functions
claims.evidence: Generic marketing language, not a checkable fact from any photo.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may have internal electrical/mechanical fault
risks.proof: Video of machine powered on, display lighting up, and a test copy being produced

risks.risk: Drum/toner/fuser may be worn or near end-of-life despite seller claim
risks.proof: Photo of maintenance counter screen and/or opened drum unit with visible wear/date code
risks.if_unproven: priced as original/unreplaced consumables nearing end of life

risks.risk: Actual page count may be far higher than claimed
risks.proof: Clear photo or video of the total counter/report page from the machine's menu
risks.if_unproven: priced as high page count / heavy use unit

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage (cracks, missing panels, broken hinges) concealed under plastic wrap
risks.proof: Photos with wrap fully removed, all sides and top cover closed

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, trays, manuals, toner cartridges)
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory set laid out together with the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare unit only, no accessories

risks.proof: Photo of serial number plate plus any service/maintenance log or invoice

proof_requests: Video of the copier powered on, producing a live test copy
Clear photo of the internal page/counter display showing total copies made
Photo of the drum and toner unit removed/open, showing install date or condition
Photos with all plastic wrap removed, all panels and trays visible
Photo of the serial number plate and any service/maintenance documentation
Photo of complete accessory set (power cable, trays, manuals)
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Sharp AR-M207 photocopier, so it can be priced, but since function, consumables condition, page count, and hidden damage are all unverified, it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
